title: Integral pullback and completed tensor product preserve constructibility
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with uniformizer
$\varpi_E$, $A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$, and a morphism $f:X\to Y$ of
schemes on which $\ell$ is invertible. Let $D^b_c(W,\mathcal O_E)$ ($W\in\{X,Y\}$)
be the derived-complete integral constructible categories, and let $Lf^*$ and
$\widehat\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_E}$ be the integral derived pullback and
completed tensor product. Then:

1. for $K\in D^b_c(Y,\mathcal O_E)$ one has $Lf^*K\in D^b_c(X,\mathcal O_E)$,
and for every $n$ the canonical map gives
$(Lf^*K)\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_E}A_{E,n}\cong f^{-1}(K\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_E}A_{E,n})$;
2. for $M,N\in D^b_c(W,\mathcal O_E)$ one has
$M\widehat\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_E}N\in D^b_c(W,\mathcal O_E)$, and
$(M\widehat\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_E}N)\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_E}A_{E,n}\cong
(M\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_E}A_{E,n})\otimes^L_{A_{E,n}}(N\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_E}A_{E,n})$
for every $n$.
